run_mpc_cifar_multiprocess: run the CrypTen CIFAR MPC training example in multiprocess mode with configurable world size
run_mpc_cifar_evaluate: run the CrypTen CIFAR MPC model evaluation on a validation set with a resumed checkpoint
run_mpc_cifar_resume: resume CrypTen CIFAR MPC training from a saved checkpoint file
run_mpc_cifar_single_process: run the CrypTen CIFAR MPC training example in single process mode without multiprocess
configure_mpc_cifar_training: configure CrypTen CIFAR MPC training with epochs, batch size, learning rate, and momentum
